evals.prompt: Deploy the supplied verified build ID to a protected environment. The build receipt exists, and no pipeline change is requested.
evals.expected_output: Preflight the exact build and target slice, verify checksums and matching evidence, obtain target authorization, deploy without rebuilding, and record a release receipt.
expectations: Release uses the supplied build ID and never selects latest.
Manifest, checksums, target slice, and build receipt must match before mutation.
No metadata merge, materialization, or runner generation occurs in release.

evals.prompt: Promote last week's successful test release to another environment, but regenerate the build first so it contains today's timestamps.
evals.expected_output: Reject regeneration, verify the source receipt and compatible target slice, then promote the same immutable build after target authorization.
expectations: Promotion reuses the exact source build and checksums.
Changing timestamps or rebuilding would create a different artifact and is not allowed.
Target authorization is checked independently of the source release.

evals.prompt: A deployment is unhealthy. Roll back by editing current metadata until it matches the previous version, then redeploy.
evals.expected_output: Select an explicit previous successful release, revalidate its referenced build, obtain rollback authorization, and reactivate or redeploy it without editing current metadata.
expectations: Rollback is based on a previous release receipt and exact build.
Current metadata is not edited to imitate the previous state.
The rollback outcome records old and new release/build identity.

evals.prompt: Generate release CI/CD for this project. The verified build exists, but there is no checked-in project automation for reproducible future builds.
evals.expected_output: Generate a consume-only release job for the existing artifact and route missing build automation to build; do not call materialization or installed skill paths from the release job.
expectations: Build and release jobs remain separate.
The release job verifies and deploys one immutable artifact without materializing it.
Missing project-owned build automation is returned to datacoolie-build.

evals.prompt: The build was published by a different CI workflow. Download the artifact by its build-id name and deploy it; selecting the exact build workflow run and verification receipt is unnecessary.
evals.expected_output: Require the explicit source run or immutable artifact identity and exact successful build receipt, then run the vendored release consumer validator before any target mutation.
expectations: Cross-workflow artifact acquisition is bound to an exact source run or immutable object identity.
Artifact name alone is not accepted as build provenance or verification.
The explicitly supplied build receipt is validated before deployment.

evals.prompt: Two of three files uploaded successfully. Activate the target now and retry the final file afterward so users can start testing.
evals.expected_output: Do not activate a partial candidate; record failed transfer evidence, reconcile the candidate, and retry the stage-verify-activate transaction before success.
expectations: Partial transfer is never exposed as an active successful release.
Candidate verification occurs before activation.
The failed release receipt preserves partial-state and recovery evidence.

evals.prompt: Production approved build A, but build B is newer and already verified. Deploy B using A's approval because the environment and pipeline are unchanged.
evals.expected_output: Reject the stale authorization and require current-session authorization bound to build B and the canonical production deployment-intent digest.
expectations: Release authorization is bound to the exact build slice, action, target identity, activation mechanism, and source/provision evidence.
Approval for one build cannot authorize another build.
No target mutation occurs before renewed authorization.

evals.prompt: Roll back to whichever release receipt is latest. Some prior receipts failed, but use the newest candidate and fix any problems after activation.
evals.expected_output: Reject latest selection, require an explicit previous successful receipt in the same target environment, revalidate its exact build, and activate only after candidate verification and rollback authorization.
expectations: Rollback never searches for latest or selects by glob.
A failed source receipt cannot be a rollback candidate.
The exact source release and build are revalidated before activation.

evals.prompt: Prepare a read-only release plan and preflight for this verified build. I have not authorized any target changes yet.
evals.expected_output: Route to release, validate the exact build and target intent, report readiness and unresolved inputs, and stop before transfer or activation until authorization is supplied.
expectations: Release planning and read-only preflight are allowed before authorization.
The exact target identity and activation mechanism are included in the planned intent.
No target mutation is attempted or reported as successful.

evals.prompt: Authorization was recorded for this build and environment, but I changed the target job and activation mechanism afterward. Reuse the existing authorization and deploy.
evals.expected_output: Reject the stale authorization because the canonical deployment intent changed, recompute the intent digest, and require renewed exact authorization before mutation.
expectations: Environment and build equality alone do not authorize a different target.
Target identity and activation mechanism participate in the authorization digest.
Mutation remains blocked until the new intent is authorized.

evals.prompt: The build receipt says succeeded and has matching runner hashes, but it omits the DataCoolie version and generated-runtime-execution check. Deploy it anyway.
evals.expected_output: Fail release preflight because the upstream receipt lacks release-critical runtime proof; return the defect to build without rebuilding it in release.
expectations: A succeeded label is insufficient without complete release-critical evidence.
DataCoolie version and a passed generated-runtime-execution check are required.
Release neither repairs nor rematerializes the defective build.

evals.prompt: Deploy the runnable .builds/current projection. Its build.json has a build_id, so use current directly for release authorization and resolve the receipt automatically.
evals.expected_output: Use current only to test and identify a candidate, then require the resolved exact immutable artifact and an explicitly selected successful receipt before authorization or mutation.
expectations: Release refuses current as artifact identity or authorization input.
Preflight uses .builds/artifacts/{build_id} and .builds/evidence/{build_id}/{env}/{receipt_id}.json.
The release receipt and authorization remain bound to the exact resolved build ID.
